standing: Independent OWNER/REFERENCE review of frozen 371 r2. Not acceptance, not five-field binding, not S9.3, not OS qualification.
requiredFindings: Adoption lacks a distinct reservation/completion clause: ordinary first-use is create-new marker after namespace; explicit adoption may begin with an exact admitted-bundle marker at the new root and must reconfirm that marker's durability and must not create-new/overwrite. r2 ordinary path (draft steps 1-4) and generic reservation_completion(absent namespace, exact marker) do not name that distinction.

RESERVED + exact marker + absent namespace is an explicit-recovery (or adoption-completion) observation, not a lawful ordinary first-use crash prefix. Ordinary order is RESERVED then namespace then create-new marker; an exact marker before the namespace directory cannot occur on that path. Model recovery-prefix-* names are supplied observations, not native reachability proofs.

initialNamespaceFootprint.challenge: Empty files are legitimate flock carriers; creating them is lock-inode publication, not holding a lease. r2 says RESERVED cannot grant a project lease. Still missing an explicit sentence that flock on RESERVED/ABANDONED N files is lease-on-unregistered-namespace (not BUSY-as-admission). complete-initial is a supplied token, not a proof of the two-file footprint.
